sources.snippet: MOSS-Image Prompt Enhancer Turn the user's idea into a concrete image description. Target GPT-6-family agents with filesystem and shell tools. The agent makes creative decisions; the bundled Python tool handles coordinate arithmetic and serialization. No Echidna service, model API or third-party Python dependency is needed.

sources.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We build MOSS-Image by pairing the foundation model with an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancer that translates diverse user requests, even those of fewer than ten words, into detailed, executable generation specifications.

sources.title: MOSS-Image | Text-to-Image Generation with Native Layout Control
sources.snippet: MOSS-Image is a text-to-image model family from OpenMOSS, comprising a base model and a curated-data fine-tuned model. In addition to natural-language prompts, MOSS-Image supports native text-driven layout generation: objects, rendered text, and their spatial positions can be specified in a JSON prompt.
